svg.text: aws-cicd-platform: multi-environment CI/CD on AWS (Mumbai, ap-south-1)
build once, promote the same image: dev on every push, prod after approval with canary and automatic rollback
a failing deployment stops and rolls back by itself
/version shows the commit SHA that is live
prod (Terraform workspace: prod) blue/green with automatic rollback
moves ALB listener traffic blue <-> green (10%, then 100%)
alarm fires during a deploy => stop, send all traffic back to blue,
pipeline DeployProd fails, prod stays on the last good version
Everything above is Terraform (remote state in S3)
Teardown script + billing check after every session: nothing billable is left running.
